modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On March 23, 1888: In England, The Football League, the world's oldest professional association football league, meets for the first time.
On March 23, 2020: Prime Minister Boris Johnson puts the United Kingdom into its first national lockdown in response to COVID-19.
On March 23, 2014: The World Health Organization (WHO) reports cases of Ebola in the forested rural region of southeastern Guinea, marking the beginning of the largest Ebola outbreak in history.
On March 23, 1978: The first UNIFIL troops arrive in Lebanon for a peacekeeping mission along the Blue Line.

did_you_know.fact: On March 23, 1965: NASA launches Gemini 3, the United States' first two-man space flight (crew: Gus Grissom and John Young).
